name: codex-usage-bubble
description: A draggable Windows bubble for live Codex 5-hour and weekly usage.

interface.shortDescription: Live 5-hour and weekly Codex usage on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Install and manage a draggable, always-on-top Windows bubble that reads signed-in Codex 5-hour and weekly usage locally, switches windows on click, hides to the system tray, lowers its water level as usage runs out, blends from green through amber to red, and refreshes automatically.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my usage bubble is running.
